name: generate_report
title: Generate Analysis Report
description: Runs all registered Reports generators and aggregates their markdown output. Built-in reports cover the data description (Magic, MIME, etc.) and overlays; future plugins can register more. The result contains both the combined 'report' string and a per-section 'sections' array so the LLM can pick which sections to surface. Reports may touch overlays (main-thread state), so this tool runs on the main thread.
